# Happy New Year 2027 — Cosmic Spacetime Countdown & 3D WebGL Celebration Experience

> An immersive, cinematic 3D WebGL interactive experience welcoming Happy New Year 2027.

## Core Information
- **Title**: Happy New Year 2027 (Into 2027)
- **Creator**: Yashraj Patil (Morningstar777-star)
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/Morningstar777-star/Happy-New-Year-2027
- **Target Event**: Global Happy New Year 2027 (January 1, 2027 00:00:00 Local/Global)
- **Deployment Platform**: Netlify (Static Web Application)
- **License**: MIT License

## Interactive Journey Structure
1. **Cosmic Spacetime Dive**:
   - Three.js WebGL procedural cosmic wormhole tunnel with reactive shaders.
   - Relativistic black hole simulation featuring gravitational lensing and blooming accretion disk.
   - Smart grapheme text animation displaying philosophical greetings in English and Marathi.
2. **Ambient Winter Countdown**:
   - Liquid glassmorphism countdown timer measuring exact days, hours, minutes, and seconds until 2027.
   - Animated chromatic color-cycling winter atmosphere.
   - Dynamic recipient wish parsing from URL query parameters (`?from=Name`).
3. **Celebratory Fireworks & Calligraphy**:
   - Real-time particle fireworks physics with twig branch growth and star twinkles.
   - High-fidelity animated SVG stroke calligraphy revealing "Happy New Year".
   - Shimmering golden 2027 typographic emblem with particle glow.
4. **Viral Personalization Engine**:
   - One-click personalized greeting creator with direct WhatsApp and X (Twitter) sharing.

## Technical Architecture
- **Rendering**: Three.js WebGL (v0.163.0), Canvas 2D particle engine, GLSL fragment and vertex shaders
- **Animation**: GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform v3.12.2), CSS3 hardware-accelerated keyframes
- **Typography**: Cinzel, Montserrat, Inter, Great Vibes, Tiro Devanagari Marathi
- **Audio Engine**: Dual-stream spatial HTML5 Audio with crossfading and global mute control
- **SEO Standards**: Schema.org JSON-LD (WebApplication, Event, FAQPage), OpenGraph, Twitter Cards, robots.txt, sitemap.xml
